reason: The observation is literally true but describes no defect: in public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:560-572 the hooks (useFolder, useGrafanaRulesSilenceSupport, useCanSilenceInFolder) run unconditionally before `if (!rule) return [false, false]`, which is what the Rules of Hooks require, and useFolder(undefined) passes skipToken (useFolder.ts:16) so no bogus request is made. The patch does not modify useCanSilence at all.
